race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: THE ANTHONY GOVER won twice at Wolverhampton over 9.5f in September and has held form well since so he's bound to be bang there if coping with the drop back in trip and different track. Musical Soldier is also proving most consistent and can be his biggest threat. THE ANTHONY GOVER MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE) VICTORY SOUND (IRE)
